widths.note: 143' printed for the wide section west of Elm

notes: SPLIT SHEET: two separately framed parts with a break line at y~2200. Upper part = W 3rd to W Pearl, lower part = W Pearl to W 2nd; W Pearl is drawn in BOTH parts (upper at y~1600, lower at y~2870), so the two parts need separate georeferencing (each intersection carries part upper/lower). Duane is printed DUANE (UNION) (sheet 14 prints UNION); it and Burrows (28') run Elm to Race and end at both (T). Pearl jogs at Race: 40' west of Race, 50' east of Race with the east leg ~18 ft further north; the Race/Pearl points are the centre of the four block corners. West of Elm, Pearl is the 143' wide section (see sheet 12). Neighbouring-sheet blocks (12, 14, 15, 5) are drawn as outlines only and are a little schematic.
